errors.text: No cited evidence establishes that coherent B2 nanoprecipitates can be produced in Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr by the proposed aging treatment or by 0.5-1.0 at.% Al/Si additions.
The density target of 10.0-10.5 g/cm³ does not clearly improve upon the actual HfMoTaTiZr baseline density of 10.44 g/cm³, so the central density limitation is not reliably addressed.

The falsification thresholds do not match the hypothesis: an alloy with 1.1 GPa yield strength and 6% ductility would fail the stated predictions of greater than 1.5 GPa and 10% but would not falsify the hypothesis under the proposed rule.
